_why: The PLACES a beat can happen in (runtime/world.tsx draws them; scripts/validate.py and render_remotion.py read this same table). A place is named from the beat's SUBJECT — where the thing it shows actually is — never chosen as decoration; a beat about an idea, a list or a word names none. Each place stands on its own ground (space is dark whatever the film's paper is), which makes it a declared ground: only a register that follows a declared ground may stand in it.

orbit.for: a thing in space: a satellite, a station, a probe in orbit — the Earth below as a whole disc, stars

sky.for: looking up from the ground: the sky, weather, things high above a city — blue sky, clouds, rooftops

field.for: outdoors in nature: a farm, a field, a hillside, plants and animals in the open — rolling ground under a sky

room.for: indoors: a home, an office, a kitchen, a device on a table — a wall, a floor, a window
